correctness.rationale: Four distinct Walsh coordinates are equivalent under affine automorphisms to either a four-type square (frequency sum zero) or an eight-type affine cube (sum nonzero). Rank failure in square case is missing a row type; in cube case the deficient type supports have sizes 1,2,3 and exactly 12 coplanar four-types. Hypergeometric inclusion-exclusion gives respectively 4*C(3N/4,m)-6*C(N/2,m)+4*C(N/4,m) and 12*C(N/2,m)+8*C(3N/8,m)-68*C(N/4,m)+72*C(N/8,m), each over C(N,m). At N=8,m=4 direct exhaustive exact rank over all 70 row subsets yields 54 and 12 failures (27/35 and 6/35), matching the formula. Asymptotic factors follow from products with m^2/N->0.
